nodes.label: outputs/vault-analysis.json is a maintenance artifact, not a canonical LLM Wiki knowledge page

nodes.label: Its size and repetitive data would consume substantial retrieval context and could dominate embeddings or indexing
nodes.norm_label: raw audit json would consume retrieval context

nodes.label: Browser-history stubs produce mass false-positive unlinked mentions in the audit report
nodes.norm_label: browser-history stubs produce mass false-positive unlinked mentions in the audit report

nodes.label: A cleanup tool could create thousands of false links from the unlinked-mention list, so these mentions should not be converted automatically into wikilinks
nodes.norm_label: do not bulk create links from unlinked mentions

nodes.label: An empty duplicates array is not evidence that the vault has no clones or versioned copies
nodes.norm_label: an empty duplicates array is not evidence that the vault has no clones or versioned copies

nodes.label: An empty duplicates result must not be used as evidence that similarly named or versioned files can be merged
nodes.norm_label: dedupe must not rest on the duplicates field

nodes.label: ACP in the Zed ecosystem is the Agent Client Protocol, not the Agent Code Protocol the note claims
nodes.norm_label: acp is the agent client protocol, not the agent code protocol the note claims

nodes.label: The report's by_folder key collapses nested categories into leaf-style names and cannot describe the PARA hierarchy
nodes.norm_label: the report's by_folder key collapses nested categories into leaf-style names and cannot describe the para hierarchy

nodes.label: The outputs folder is absent from by_folder, so the scanner evidently excluded its own output directory
nodes.norm_label: the outputs folder is absent from by_folder, so the scanner evidently excluded its own output directory

nodes.label: That exclusion is not documented, and without it the report could recursively affect its own statistics
nodes.norm_label: undocumented self exclusion makes the report possibly recursive

nodes.label: scripts/lib/redaction-selftest.test.mjs is the executable guard that makes best-effort redaction falsifiable
nodes.norm_label: scripts/lib/redaction-selftest.test.mjs is the executable guard that makes best-effort redaction falsifiable

nodes.label: Redaction is a best-effort net over tool output written into an auto-committed vault, so this test is what makes best-effort falsifiable
nodes.norm_label: redaction is a best-effort net, so this test is what makes best-effort falsifiable

nodes.label: A synthetic sample per PATTERNS entry, with the sampled key set asserted equal to PATTERN_NAMES in both directions
nodes.norm_label: a synthetic sample per patterns entry, with the sampled key set asserted equal to pattern_names in both directions

nodes.label: An untested pattern is a silent gap, so a pattern with no sample must be an explicit failure rather than a skip
nodes.norm_label: an untested pattern is a silent gap, not a skip

nodes.label: The credential-query needles are assembled from string fragments so the scanning file cannot match its own source
nodes.norm_label: the credential-query needles are assembled from string fragments so the scanning file cannot match its own source

nodes.label: A self-test that hunts a string and then spells that string in its own title can never pass, so the needles are built from fragments ('credent' + 'ial') and the file does not match itself
nodes.norm_label: a self-test that spells the string it hunts can never pass

nodes.label: A JWT nested inside a PEM block is swallowed by pem-private-key: the secret is removed and counted, but jwt records nothing
nodes.norm_label: a jwt nested inside a pem block is swallowed by pem-private-key: the secret is removed and counted, but jwt records nothing

nodes.label: pem-private-key is index 3 and jwt is index 4, so the broad pattern replaces the block first and the narrow one never sees the text; the safety property holds but the note can no longer say a JWT was there, so jwt === 1 was deliberately not asserted and a future reordering must force that trade-off to be decided
nodes.norm_label: pattern order pem before jwt loses attribution, so jwt === 1 was deliberately not asserted

nodes.label: Three separate mutations each falsified one guard: an unplanted pattern, a planted credential query, and a weakened aws pattern
nodes.norm_label: three separate mutations each falsified one guard: an unplanted pattern, a planted credential query, and a weakened aws pattern

nodes.label: A green guard proves nothing unless it can go red, and the first mutation attempt silently no-opped on bad anchor text, so that was reported rather than treated as a pass
nodes.norm_label: a green guard proves nothing unless it can go red

nodes.label: The optional render-session integration test skipped cleanly, then was proven non-vacuous against a leaky and a redacting stand-in renderer in a throwaway copy outside the repo
nodes.norm_label: the optional render-session integration test skipped cleanly, then was proven non-vacuous against a leaky and a redacting stand-in renderer

nodes.label: Since a skip that can never fail is decoration, the test couples to the documented T6 signature renderSession(session, messages, opts) on purpose, because a guard that adapts to whatever the renderer happens to be isn't a guard
nodes.norm_label: a skip that can never fail is decoration

nodes.label: Every secret in the redaction self-test is synthetic and assembled in-code from visible fragments so a test run cannot print a real credential
nodes.norm_label: every secret in the redaction self-test is synthetic and assembled in-code from visible fragments so a test run cannot print a real credential
